---
name: Office Connect work request
about: A feature, fix or phone usability request
---

## Desired result

What should happen, and on which page?

## Current behavior

What happens now? Add a redacted screenshot if useful.

## Acceptance

- [ ] The main action works with synthetic data.
- [ ] The changed flow is usable on the target phone/browser.

## Context

Device/browser, relevant role, and anything that must be preserved.
For a bug, include reproduction steps and expected/actual behavior.
Do not include passwords, tokens, personal records or raw production logs.
